items.title: Bristol Myers Squibb (BMY) Adds Restricted Pharmacy Path For New Myeloma Drug
items.summary: Bristol-Myers Squibb (NYSE:BMY) has picked Onco360 to join the restricted specialty pharmacy network for ZENBEXUS (iberdomide). ZENBEXUS, a newly approved therapy for certain multiple myeloma patients, will be dispensed through a Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy program. Onco360 will handle specialty dispensing and clinical support for eligible patients as ZENBEXUS enters commercial rollout for an underserved group.
